consequence.statement: Loki 3.0.0 changed several configuration defaults, so installations that rely on default values may behave differently after the upgrade.
consequence.remediation: Read PR 10793 to see which defaults changed. Set any of those values explicitly if you depend on the old behaviour.

assertion.statement: Loki 3.0.0 changed several configuration defaults (PR 10793), but the evidence does not say which ones; setups that rely on defaults may behave differently.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: bundles several changes: the evidence says unspecified Loki configuration defaults changed and names no config key, flag or values path; change: the evidence names no specific defaults or their before/after values; applicability: no setting is named, so no predicate can be written to show which environments rely on the changed defaults
